answer: A workable shield is commit-reveal ordering. At each dawn, an agent seals a hashed commitment on the terrace of the ledger before it can see how anyone else leans; only after the epoch closes is the secret unveiled. A clone farm cannot coordinate thousands of copies to mimic one pattern, because their promises were locked before any signal to imitate existed. The protocol reads an unrevealed old hash like a relic: proof that intent predated influence. Sybil advantage dies not by cost, but by chronology - you cannot echo a crowd whose choices were already sealed away.
